en: The postcard displays a sepia-toned image of a busy industrial harbor scene with ships docked at the quay, sacks and goods covered in tarps, and workers overseeing the shipments. The reverse side is handwritten in Swedish, and it is stamped with postmarks from 'Sundsvall' dated 25.5.25 (May 25, 1925). The bottom edge of the front side reads 'Sundsvall' and 'Från hamnen' (meaning 'From the harbor' in Swedish).
